title: Tiago Danin
summary: Mobile developer and bug hunter from Belem, Brazil. Native and cross-platform apps (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native), open source maintenance, and security research.
note: Content is published in English and Portuguese. A Portuguese page lives under the /pt suffix of its English route, and every HTML page has a Markdown mirror at the same path with a .md extension.
